alignright.zh: 只将 align 改为 right：完整序列的显示右端对齐。
alignright.en: Only align changes to right: complete sequence right edges align.

alignanchor.en: Keep left alignment and add midpoint anchors; these geometric anchors do not assert homology.

alignauto.zh: 只启用自动显示方向，采用默认支持阈值 0.1；行顺序和原始端点不变。

tracktile.zh: 同一批真实 GC 窗口：固定宽度色带用颜色表示比例，色带高度不编码 GC。
tracktile.en: The same real GC windows: a fixed-width band encodes fraction by colour, not height.

comparegeneshouldered.zh: 同一个真实 integrase：默认 shouldered 箭头。
comparegeneshouldered.en: The same source integrase: default shouldered arrow.

comparegeneflush.zh: 只把 arrow_head_style 改为 flush。

comparegenetriangle.zh: 只把 arrow_head_style 改为 triangle，整个区间采用三角楔形。
comparegenetriangle.en: Only arrow_head_style changes to triangle, a full triangular wedge.

comparebranchnone.zh: 简化示意：相同 query 区间的两条带独立绘制。
comparebranchnone.en: Synthetic demonstration: two ribbons from the same query interval, drawn independently.

comparebranchquery.zh: 同一简化输入，只启用 query 分支，默认比例 0.15。
comparebranchquery.en: Same synthetic input: enable query branching at the default 0.15 fraction.

comparebranchfraction.zh: 保持 query 分支，只将主干比例从 0.15 改为 0.35。
comparebranchfraction.en: Keep query branching and change only the trunk fraction from 0.15 to 0.35.

comparelinkcurve.zh: 同一简化输入，用曲线连接区间中点。
comparelinkcurve.en: Same synthetic input: curved links connect interval midpoints.

comparelinkstraight.zh: 只把 link_type 改为 straight，中点锚定不变。

comparefixedinside.zh: 只把固定标签放在内侧。

comparefixedrotate.zh: 只给固定标签增加 30 度旋转。

comparewrapfit.zh: 只指定 14 字符换行宽度，标签文字仍由源名称和坐标组成。

comparepositionidentity.zh: 原始同一位置上的实际重叠注释。

compareprimerlabel.zh: 引物文字默认包含真实结合范围。
compareprimerlabel.en: Primer labels include actual binding ranges by default.

comparerestrictionelbow.en: Change only leader routing to elbow.

comparerestrictionstraight.en: Change only leader routing to straight.

comparerestrictionenzyme.en: Show only enzyme names; retain cut coordinates in data.

comparerestrictionposition.zh: 只显示位置，原始酶名不丢弃。
comparerestrictionposition.en: Show only positions; source enzyme names are retained.

compareshortwedge.zh: 同一真实 CDS，请求较长头部以观察 wedge 回退。
compareshortwedge.en: Same observed CDS with an oversized requested head to demonstrate wedge fallback.

compareshortblock.zh: 同一真实 CDS，请求较长头部以观察 block 回退。
compareshortblock.en: Same observed CDS with an oversized requested head to demonstrate block fallback.

compareseqlabelarc.zh: 默认序列文字沿弧排布。
compareseqlabelarc.en: Default sequence text follows each arc.

compareseqlabelhorizontal.zh: 只把序列文字改为横排。
compareseqlabelhorizontal.en: Change only sequence text orientation to horizontal.

compareseqlabelrotation.en: Add only 30 degrees to arc-oriented sequence text.

comparethemedark.zh: 只替换为 dark 主题，序列与映射保留。
comparethemedark.en: Change only to the dark theme, retaining sequences and mappings.

comparebandwidth.zh: 只将实际 band 骨架宽度从 0.035 改为 0.07。
comparebandwidth.en: Change only actual band width from 0.035 to 0.07.

comparefeaturearrow.zh: 同六条真实注释，通用 arrow 几何。

compareregionwidth.zh: 同一真实 query 区间，只把宽度从 0.08 改为 0.14。

compareregionoffset.zh: 只把 region_offset 从 0 改为 0.1，区间不变。
compareregionoffset.en: Change only region_offset from 0 to 0.1, retaining the interval.

foundationsankey.en: Mirrored source sequences: query intervals on the left, subject intervals on the right.

foundationcount.zh: 在源坐标统计真实 query 起点观测数。
foundationcount.en: Counts of actual query-start observations in source coordinates.

foundationequal.zh: 等长视觉投影保留真实局部轴，并显式选择 Identity 填充。
foundationequal.en: Equal visual lengths with true local axes and explicitly selected identity fill.
